title: Universal Follow Behind free
features:
Auto-Follow – keeps you fixed directly behind the target player
Smooth Tweening – natural movement, no snapping
Dynamic Distance – constantly updates spacing to stay consistent
Back Lock – always faces the target’s back automatically
Sorted Player List – nearest to furthest, updates in real time
GUI Controls – draggable, minimizable interface
Real-Time Tracking – stays locked even if the target runs or teleports
Toggle On/Off – quick control to enable or disable at will
